mapper.insert: insert into qa_conversation(user_id, title, created_time, updated_time, deleted) values(#{userId}, #{title}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, title, created_time as createdTime, updated_time as updatedTime, deleted from qa_conversation where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0
select id, title, created_time as createdTime, updated_time as updatedTime from qa_conversation where user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 order by updated_time desc
